onboarding.help_translate_body: Most translations start out machine made. Corrections are welcome at tmplayer.org/translate.
onboarding.notifications_body: TMPlayer can tell you when a download finishes and when a new episode of a show you are watching is posted. You choose which ones in Settings, and you can turn them off any time.
onboarding.notifications_off_body: Android will not show its question again. You can turn notifications on in the system settings, or leave them off: downloads still run, and you can follow them in Downloads.
onboarding.support_body: TMPlayer is free and open source, with no ads of our own and no paid tier. If it is useful to you, a voluntary gift helps keep it going and improve it. It unlocks nothing: everything works the same either way.

syncchannel.block_count_unknown: Telegram has not said how many people are in this channel, so TMPlayer cannot be sure it is only you. Nothing is written there. The sync file stays in Saved Messages until Telegram answers.
syncchannel.block_gone: TMPlayer cannot find this channel any more: it was deleted, or you are no longer in it. The sync file stays in Saved Messages. Choose another channel, or go back to Saved Messages here.
syncchannel.block_group: This is a group, not a channel, so TMPlayer does not write there. The sync file stays in Saved Messages. Choose a private channel instead.
syncchannel.block_left: You left this channel, so TMPlayer does not write there. The sync file stays in Saved Messages. Join it again as its owner, or choose another channel.
syncchannel.block_linked: A discussion group is linked to this channel, so everyone in that group can read what is posted there, even when you are the only member. TMPlayer does not write there. The sync file stays in Saved Messages. Unlink the group in Telegram, or choose another channel.
syncchannel.block_members: This channel now has {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}, not only you, so TMPlayer stopped writing there. The sync file stays in Saved Messages. What is already in the channel can be read by the others: delete it there in Telegram if you do not want that.
syncchannel.block_not_owner: You are not the owner of this channel, so TMPlayer does not write there. The sync file stays in Saved Messages. Choose a channel you own.
syncchannel.block_posting: Telegram does not let this account post in the channel right now (it is restricted, or the account is limited). The sync file stays in Saved Messages and the channel is tried again in an hour.
syncchannel.block_public: This channel has a public name, so anyone can join it and TMPlayer does not write there. The sync file stays in Saved Messages. Make the channel private in Telegram, or choose another.
syncchannel.channel_description: Private. Only you are in this channel. TMPlayer keeps its sync file and your backups here. Do not add anyone.
syncchannel.choose_none: No private channel of yours was found in your chat list. Create one in Telegram, or press Create it for me.
syncchannel.create_confirm_body: TMPlayer asks Telegram to create a private channel with only you in it. It writes only its own sync file and your backups there, never adds anyone, and stops writing the moment anyone else is in it. You can delete the channel in Telegram at any time.
syncchannel.created: Done. The sync file and your backups now go to {name}.
syncchannel.created_unverified: {name} was created, but Telegram has not yet confirmed that only you are in it, so it is not in use. Choose it from your channels in a moment.

syncchannel.guide_step2: Add nobody. Only you may be in it, and never share its invite link.
syncchannel.guide_step3: Come back here and choose it, or let TMPlayer create it for you.
syncchannel.guide_tv: Press Create it for me. TMPlayer makes a private channel with only you in it and starts using it. Nothing to type.
syncchannel.intro: By default the sync file and your backups go to Saved Messages. If you would rather keep them out of that chat, use a private channel of your own with only you in it.
syncchannel.no_space: There is not enough free space on this device to prepare the file. Free some space and try again.
syncchannel.old_copy: An older copy of the file is still in {place}. TMPlayer leaves it there: delete it in Telegram if you do not need it.
syncchannel.picked: Done. The sync file and your backups now go to {name}.
syncchannel.privacy: TMPlayer checks before every write that you own the channel, that it is private and that you are the only member. If that stops being true, it writes nothing there and uses Saved Messages.
syncchannel.reused: Found {name}, which was made before, so no new channel was created. It is in use now.

syncchannel.row_detail: Saved Messages, or a private channel of your own with only you in it

web.install_ios_before_sign_in: Best done before you sign in: the Home Screen app keeps its own sign in.
web.install_ios_body: It opens full screen, like an app, and keeps your sign in and places.
web.install_ios_own_sign_in: The Home Screen app keeps its own sign in, so you sign in there once more.
web.install_ios_step_add: Choose Add to Home Screen, then Add
web.install_ios_step_share: Tap Share in the browser's bar
web.install_ios_title: Add TMPlayer to your Home Screen
web.install_pwa_body: It opens in its own window, and the browser keeps its data.
web.keep_storage: Keep TMPlayer's data in this browser
web.keep_storage_off: Off: when the device runs low on space, the browser may clear TMPlayer's data, which signs you out. Press to ask it to keep it
web.keep_storage_on: On: the browser keeps your sign in, settings and places even when the device runs low on space
web.keep_storage_refused: The browser did not agree. Installing TMPlayer to the home screen usually lets it keep the data
web.language_failed: {language} did not load. Check the connection and try again
web.low_storage_always: Always on in a browser: a video is streamed and only the part being played is kept, in memory, never on the disk
web.needs_app_codec: Your browser cannot play this kind of video.
web.needs_app_format: Its format, {format}, does not open in a browser.
web.needs_app_no_mse: This browser is too old to convert it for playing. Safari 17 or later, or a recent Chrome or Firefox, can.
web.needs_app_picture: Its picture is {codec}, which this browser cannot decode.
web.needs_app_picture_subtitles: Its subtitles are pictures, which the browser cannot draw.
web.needs_app_title: This video needs the TMPlayer app
web.needs_app_too_heavy: It is too heavy to decode smoothly in this browser.
web.no_sound: This browser cannot play this video's sound ({codec}), so it plays without sound.
web.not_found: There is nothing at this address.
web.notify_allow_ask: Off in this browser. Press to let TMPlayer show its notifications while it is open in a tab
web.notify_allow_blocked: Blocked for this site. Allow notifications in the browser's site settings, then come back
web.notify_allow_on: On: TMPlayer shows its notifications while it is open in a tab, also when the tab is in the background
web.notify_allow_unsupported: This browser does not show notifications for web pages. On an iPhone or iPad, add TMPlayer to the Home Screen first
web.notify_episodes_detail: When a show you are watching posts its next episode, in a chat you can see, checked about every 45 minutes while TMPlayer is open in a tab
web.notify_new_videos_detail: A notification when a starred chat posts videos, checked about every 45 minutes while TMPlayer is open in a tab
web.notify_summary: New episodes, new videos and missing parts, while TMPlayer is open in a tab
web.offline: Offline. TMPlayer carries on once the connection is back.
web.open_in_safari_body: This browser cannot keep your sign in. Copy the link and open it in Safari.
web.open_in_safari_steps: Or tap the menu or share button of this page and choose Open in Safari.
web.other_tab_body: Only one tab can use your Telegram account at a time. Close the other tab, or use TMPlayer here instead.
web.other_tab_title: TMPlayer is open in another tab
web.posters_on_detail: Looked up on TMDB by each video's cleaned-up title. Nothing else is sent, no chat, file or account.
web.proxy_detail: Set in this device's or browser's network settings
web.proxy_unavailable: In a browser, TMPlayer reaches Telegram over the browser's own secure connection, which cannot go through a Telegram proxy. To use a proxy or a VPN, set it up in this device's or browser's network settings.
web.report_stutter_detail: Marks this moment, so Copy details includes the last minute
web.request_feature_body: GitHub opens a feature request with the app version and the browser already filled in. Nothing else is sent: say what you would like, and why.
web.request_feature_detail: A feature request on GitHub with the version filled in
web.safari_clears_body: Add TMPlayer to the Home Screen to keep your sign in and your lists.
web.safari_clears_title: Safari clears this site after 7 days unused
web.save_to_device_detail: The file goes to your downloads, a piece at a time
web.settings_storage_summary: What this browser keeps for TMPlayer
web.signout_body: You'll be signed out and taken back to the sign-in screen. Your favourites, your watched list and everything you were part way through go with it.
web.slow_decode: This browser decodes this video more slowly than it plays, so it will stop now and then to catch up. The TMPlayer app plays it smoothly.
web.sound_unplayable: This browser cannot play the {codec} sound, so the sound stays as it was.
web.stopped_loading: The video stopped loading. Check your connection, then try again.
web.storage_body: Your sign in, settings and the parts of videos you played are kept in this browser only. Nothing goes to a server of ours.
web.storage_body_stream: Your sign in, settings and places are kept in this browser only, never on a server of ours. Videos are streamed: only the part playing is held, in memory.
web.storage_clear_cache_detail: Removes saved thumbnails and posters. They are fetched again when needed. Your sign in, settings and places stay.
web.storage_unavailable: This browser is not keeping TMPlayer's data, as in a private window. Your settings and places last until the tab closes.
web.storage_used: {used} used, of the {quota} this browser allows
web.stutter_marked: Stutter marked. Copy details will include the last minute.
web.switch_decoder: This browser could not play it directly, so TMPlayer is decoding it itself.
web.too_old_body: Update it, or open TMPlayer in Safari 16.4 or later, or a recent Chrome, Edge or Firefox. The TMPlayer app runs on Android phones and TVs, Windows, macOS and Linux.
web.too_old_title: This browser is too old for TMPlayer
web.turn_on_resume_sync: Keep your places in Saved Messages
web.tv_unreachable_body: This TV build opens TMPlayer from {address}. Check that the computer serving it is on and on the same network as the TV.
web.update_ready: A new version of TMPlayer is ready.
web.volume_boost_not_here: Volume boost is not available in Safari on iPhone. Use the volume buttons.

whatsnew.highlight_carousel: Home opens on a carousel of the newest videos and shows in your starred chats
whatsnew.highlight_copies: A video posted more than once is one card: pick its copy and quality, and your place follows it
whatsnew.highlight_player: Player: chapters, picture shape on the bar, finer speed steps and a way back after a long jump
whatsnew.highlight_search: Search across all your chats, with one result per video, filters and sort
whatsnew.highlight_sort: Sort each chat, rename a video or fix a wrong match
whatsnew.line_account: Your picture is where the gear was and opens your account menu: switch or add an account, open Settings or Refresh, or sign out. The version is there too
whatsnew.line_account_tv: Your picture and name are on the top bar. Press OK on it, or Menu while on the bar, to switch or add an account or to sign out
whatsnew.line_chapters: Chapters have their own page in More once a video has two or more
whatsnew.line_decoder_desktop: Options has Force software decoding and Report stutter
whatsnew.line_desktop_keys: Press ? for the keyboard shortcuts. Quitting asks first while downloads are running
whatsnew.line_languages: Pick several audio and subtitle languages in order: the first one a video has is used
whatsnew.line_play_all: Play all and Shuffle are in a chat's Sort menu and on a list's page
whatsnew.line_play_all_web: Play all is in a chat's Sort menu and on a list's page
whatsnew.line_settings_order: Settings is in a new order, by task, with Account first. A Moved to line shows where a setting went
whatsnew.line_settings_tablet: On a tablet, Settings shows the list and the page side by side
whatsnew.line_settings_tv: Settings is a list of categories on the left and the page on the right. Page and Channel keys jump between sections
whatsnew.line_subtitles: Subtitles have a finer size, a height for the bottom line, 16 colours and a This video only switch for the look
whatsnew.line_sync: Refreshing, syncing and changing chats say what they are doing: an Updating line, what could not be read, and Try again
whatsnew.line_tv_lists: Page and Channel keys move a screenful in long lists, and Back goes to the top first
whatsnew.line_tv_options: Hold OK or press Menu on a video for its options, or use the Options button above the grid
whatsnew.line_tv_seek: Left and Right jump 10 seconds both ways, hold to go faster, and the CC key turns subtitles on and off
whatsnew.line_tv_watch_later: Watch later moved from the top bar to your account menu
whatsnew.line_web_history: History sits in the bar where Downloads was, and recent searches are remembered
whatsnew.line_web_save: Save to device saves the file to your browser's downloads, after checking there is room
whatsnew.subtitle: The highlights of this version
whatsnew.title: What's new in {version}

window.drop_backup: To restore a backup, open Settings and choose Restore, then pick this file
window.drop_not_supported: TMPlayer plays videos from your Telegram chats
